answer: The comet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the wander until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the raven of the next round. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
